name: PeopleForce
summary: PeopleForce is an HR platform whose pricing page lists time-off tracking, leave requests and approvals, and custom leave policies in its plan table. Standard is listed at $2.5 and Professional at $3 per employee a month, with billing starting from 50 employees. The page does not name its currency.

facts.text: The pricing page lists Standard at $2.5 per employee a month and Professional at $3 per employee a month. It says billing starts from 50 employees.
The pricing page shows a dollar sign but does not name a currency, so the amounts are shown as listed and are not confirmed as US dollars.
The plan comparison lists time-off tracking, leave timeline, leave requests and approvals, and custom leave policies. Standard and Professional both include them.
The pricing page does not explicitly mention leave types, accrual rules or leave balances.

plans.name: Standard
plans.unit: per employee per month, billing from 50 employees
plans.notes: Listed as $2.5 per employee a month. The page does not name the currency. Includes time-off tracking and leave requests and approvals.

plans.name: Professional
plans.unit: per employee per month, billing from 50 employees
plans.notes: Listed as $3 per employee a month. The page does not name the currency. Includes everything in Standard.

hiddenCosts: Billing starts from 50 employees, so the listed per-employee price does not cover smaller teams.
The page does not say whether a free plan or free trial exists, so freePlan is set to false only because no free plan is listed.
